description: Save the current page as a PDF.

profile.description: Chrome profile name, email or directory (e.g. "Work"). Omit to use the default profile.

session.description: Task id that groups tabs into one Chrome tab group (default "mcp", which every call that omits it shares). Use ONE session per task and the same value for every call of that task, including parallel workers.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab (the tabId returned by navigate, or list_tabs). REQUIRED for parallel work: without it a call goes to the profile's shared current tab and queues behind other calls.

name: browser_save_as_pdf
